formula: fc.packet.build gives polls (weight 3 of 5) its share plus every character the other sections left unused, so polls allowance = budget - len(markets section) - len(headlines section). Live: 20000 - len_markets - len_headlines (median headlines length over the builds with gdelt_status ok). Historical: hist_budget_chars - len(markets render, empty mapping) - len(GdeltUnavailable render). hist_budget_chars is the value that makes the two equal (fc.train.packets.derive_hist_budget). A live day whose GDELT call fails gives polls the same allowance as a historical packet, because both then carry the degraded headlines render.
assumption_A10: settled by measurement: the live GDELT headlines section was 3938 of its 4000 character share
